name: Ithaca Long-Range Emplacement
desc: A fixed-installation fire-control and power-routing package. Multiplies ballistic, energy, and missile weapon range by ten.

name: Ithaca Naval Fire Control
desc: A battlespace-scale targeting array that lets colossal naval emplacements acquire targets across the combat zone.

name: Budai Maintained Distortion
desc: Halves armor and maintains a spatial distortion. Regenerates up to 50% of maximum hull per combat, tapering from 1% hull per second to zero over 100 healing seconds and pausing at full hull. At 50% hull, Budai screeches and lunges four times before the field quadruples, turns red, and doubles its Hungering Rift fire rate. Incoming fire originating beyond the field deals half damage; ships inside lose half their mobility and suffer periodic Shrouded Lens strikes.

name: Budai Pseudoparticle Manifold
desc: Overdrives Budai's Pseudoparticle Jets, increasing their width by 300% and their damage by 150%.

name: Starving Threat Hull
desc: Replaces the stock Threat Hull package for material-starved ships, preserving its combat systems while abandoning its zero-profile stealth. Ravenous emissions increase sensor profile by 200%; depleted construction trades structural mass for extreme maneuverability and denser armor. On destruction, its remaining fragments reorganize into attack swarms and may reconstruct Gautama once per ordinary battle: 10% for a frigate, 20% for a destroyer, 30% for a cruiser, and 50% for a Fabricator. During Labor V's center battle, failed rolls add 10 percentage points to the next eligible loss until Gautama returns.
short: Stock Threat behavior; 5x maneuverability; -33% hull; +15% armor; +200% sensor profile; releases attack swarms; Gautama reconstruction: 10% frigate, 20% destroyer, 30% cruiser, 50% Fabricator; Labor V gains +10% per failed roll.

name: Spartan Boarding Pod AI
desc: Keeps the boarding pod in a defensive orbit until it detects exposed hull, then commits to a boarding run.

name: Gautama Command Organism
desc: Tracks Gautama's unique battle presence and, when installed on its carrier configuration, its swarm screen.

name: Ungaikyo Reflection
desc: Marks a zero-DP combat-only reflection summoned by Ungaikyo. The copy cannot be recovered or retained after the battle.

name: Gautama Swarm Compatibility
desc: Legacy compatibility marker. Provides no damage protection or regeneration.

name: Gautama Fragile Swarm
desc: Makes Gautama's replacement escorts extremely fragile and suppresses their ship-level death explosion and hulk.
short: 25% hull; 150% hull and armor damage taken; no death explosion.

name: Omega Time-Stop Core
desc: Arrests local time, then closes directly on the opposing flagship. An active Temporal Shell remains synchronized and can move freely.
short: Periodic time stop; Temporal Shell counters.

name: Drifting Wall Foundation
desc: Hardens the colossal naval emplacements built into the Drifting Wall foundation to twenty times normal weapon durability.

name: Wall Contact Safety
desc: Prevents structural contact damage to ships while preserving weapon damage and solid collision geometry.

name: Spartan Threat Ward
desc: Legacy compatibility hullmod. Its former combat damage reduction has been removed.

name: Domain-Security IFF Transponder
desc: A permanent authentication package issued by Menelaus after accepting the first Labor. It authorizes command of recovered Domain derelict drones without Automated Ships expertise.
short: Command recovered Domain derelicts without Automated Ships.

name: Ithaca Invasion Marker
desc: Hidden compatibility marker identifying ships from an authored Ithaca invasion. It changes no combat statistics.
